narrative.overview:
Dieter Rams' industrial design, taken only where it does a job. A housing-grey panel carries the person's name as a bold type designation and lists the pages; the reading column is calm grotesque type on off-white; every piece of metadata is printed like the scale on a device, small tracked capitals with a hairline running out after it. One signal orange appears, and only as a function: where you are, what is new, what has focus, what is a link.

The theme is a reader's surface for a personal log. Density is moderate and quiet: one reading column of about 36rem, generous gaps between entries, no boxes around them. Every desktop page carries the same panel; on inner pages the article heading outranks the site name. On phones inner pages get a one-line bar and the bio moves to the footer. It works without JavaScript; the only interactive element is a native `<details>` menu on phones.

Rejected in the build's history and not to return: decorative device fronts (grilles, dials, keys, rails), shelving-system grids, poster planes, LCD dates.
keyCharacteristics: Two planes only: housing-grey panel and off-white ground, joined by a 1px seam.
Scale printing for every label, date and count.
Orange as signal, never as decoration.
Flat: no shadows, gradients or cards.
One self-hosted variable face, Schibsted Grotesk 400 to 700.

rules.name: The Orange Only As Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks state or function: current, new, focus, link, selection. It never fills a heading, a background area or an ornament. Apart from post emojis, it is the only colour on the page.

rules.name: The Anthracite Link Rule
rules.body: Link text stays anthracite; the orange lives in the underline (1px, 2px on hover).

rules.name: The Scale Printing Rule
rules.body: Dates, kinds, statuses, stacks, the domain, social links, tags, year headings, book dates, fact terms and the Menu toggle are all set as the label style in quiet grey. Digits are tabular; punctuation inside dates is reset to proportional so separators keep their width.

rules.name: The Flat Housing Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand apart, give it the panel grey or a 1px rule, never a shadow or a card.

dos: **Do** keep orange to signal duties: current square, NEW, focus, link underline, selection, current page number.
**Do** set every date, kind, status and count in the label style with tabular numerals.
**Do** give each stream entry exactly one rule, the one after its meta label.
**Do** put a post's emoji in the housing-grey slot of its meta line; project titles and page headings may carry their emoji inline.
**Do** separate with the panel grey, a 1px rule or space.
donts: **Don't** add ornament without a job: no grilles, dials, keys, rails, decorative device fronts.
**Don't** put emojis in the navigation; nav items are text plus, when current, the orange square.
**Don't** draw separators between stream entries or box entries in cards.
**Don't** use shadows, gradients or a second typeface.
**Don't** colour link text orange or use faint grey for readable text.
